f46: Rain a storm of steel upon your prey, pinning foes with bone-crushing spears before finishing them with a flurry of expertly thrown axes.
Embrace true barbarism and devastate your enemies with a powerful two-handed weapon.
Invoke the power of the North and your thirst for alcohol to support allies with short boons or powerful auras.
Embrace the teachings of Bwonsamdi and become the living embodiment of the Loa's wrath with powerful ranged attacks and shadow magic.
Embrace da voodoo, cripple and enfeeble your enemies with powerful manipulation spells.
Harness the shadows of dark alchemy to concoct potent brews and potions, channeling healing energies to empower your allies.
Empower yourself with unbound fel sorcery to rain ruin from afar, incinerating foes with volatile blasts and relentless demonic assault.
Empower your weapons with fel magic and engage in close quarters combat with enemies.
Bolster your demon form, heft twin colossal blades, and use your hulking mass to dominate the battlefield as an unbreakable tank.
Use crossbows to strike down enemies at a medium distance with unparalleled mobility.
Use guns and a shadowhound companion to blast enemies into oblivion from across the battlefield.
Use dual weapons to hunt the evil doers of Azeroth, burning them in searing flames of judgement.
Support your allies with powerful boons and control enemies using a wind servant to aid you.
Invoke the power of storms, utilizing powerful water and lightning magic in conjunction to electrocute enemies.
Obliterate the enemy through the force of lightning itself, unleashing massive bursts of energy and chaining electricity across the battlefield.
Beckon forth hellfire from the distant world of Xoroth to incinerate enemies with powerful burst attacks as an effective melee fire hybrid.
Command an army of Xorothian demons to both augment your own prowess in battle, and defend your allies, as a juggernaut from hell.
Butcher your enemies with savage slashes and brutal cleaves, tearing through flesh as a relentless, blood-soaked juggernaut.
Destroy enemies using a shield as a master of the arena, devastating your opponents with powerful kicks and trapping them in nets.
Lead from the front with rousing speeches, war banners, and heroic ballads that embolden allies and shatter enemy resolve.
Charge into the fray and protect your allies from harm with a massive shield and heavy defensive capability.
Guard allies with disciplined martial mastery, parrying blows and staggering incoming damage before answering with decisive counterattacks.
Overwhelm enemies in a chain of zealous strikes of growing potency that shatter even the most steadfast defenses.
Cleave through enemies in a tempest of righteous steel, unleashing your oaths to crush multiple foes at once.
Weave flesh and blood into empowering rites, bolstering allies with potent boons while mending wounds in critical moments.
Embrace the Curse of the Vampyr as a shadow caster, feeding an insatiable thirst that empowers your blood magic at ever-rising cost.
Utilize an enhanced cursed form to weave in and out of battle as both a melee damage dealer and a caster simultaneously.
Assault enemies from a distance with ranged weapons utilizing various powerful quivers to take down your foes.
Dominate the battlefield with ease with powerful ranged spells and utility, all while supporting your allies with horns and calling falcons into the fray.
Stalk your prey with ruthless precision, assaulting them from close range, opening grievous wounds to bleed them out.
Bend the flow of aeons to mend wounds, delay incoming damage, and outmaneuver fate itself with elegant temporal mastery.
Rampant chaotic energies flow through you as you channel the power of the Infinite Dragonflight and use them with purpose to unmake your enemies.
Weave fragmented echoes of time into your wand attacks to continually empower them or unleash single bursts of magic damage.
Spread foul plagues upon enemies to wither them over time and rot your foes with devastating diseases.
Raise vast hordes of expendable undead minions, increase the power of your horde, and use their command effects to destroy your enemies.
Unleash your inner Lich. Utilize frost magic to damage and control enemies, chilling them to the bone alongside undead giants.
Find solace in the caress of flames, where healing ignites the spirit and rekindles the hope in the heart of battle.
Stoke incinerating flames, burning enemies to a crisp, and leaving them writhing in agony.
Ascend into an empowered state and obliterate enemies with powerful magic granted to you by the Dragon Aspects.
Embrace insanity on the battlefield, healing allies with the power of Yogg-Saron in a crazed melee fervor.
Channel C'thun's destructive gaze, unleashing devastating void magics upon the battlefield.
Imbue your weapon with the power of N'Zoth, acting as a forceful herald of his plans.
Embrace the Lunar Cycles, harnessing their power influencing magical waters to heal allies.
Join the Sentinels to unleash enchanted arrows lit by the Moon's everpresent glow.
Become an avatar of Elune’s wrath, sundering foes with relentless lunar strikes and dispensing indiscriminate justice.
Wield sanctified flame and holy wrath in tandem, searing corruption away and reducing enemies into purified ash.
Become the Light’s wrath made flesh, carving through foes with a greatblade in each hand as a storm of merciless holy steel.
Swear a radiant oath to guard your allies, standing as an unyielding bulwark that turns aside harm beneath the sun.
Detonate powerful explosives, launch rockets, and build deadly contraptions to sow chaos and destruction amongst your enemies.
Upgrade your turrets and clockwork allies while collecting scrap to build a jet-fueled mechsuit, unlocking enhanced abilities.
Heal yourself and allies with a vast array of nanobots and modules, and build powerful beacons to empower your allies.
Harden your form with a regenerating chitinous exoskeleton, fortifying your weak points to endure punishing enemy assaults.
Take on the form of a spider to strike down foes from the shadows with powerful Nature and Shadow magic.
Weave together poisons and fungal blights that rot your enemies from within, leaving behind volatile growths that erupt in their wake.
Skulk around in the realm of shadows, bringing the cold chill of death upon enemies.
Reap the life essence of your foes to empower crushing two-handed strikes, sustaining your onslaught through stolen vitality.
Crush your foes with powerful soul magic while parrying their attacks and dominate those who come before you with spectral scythes and spectral wardens.
Invoke untamed nature into restorative surges, healing wounds and fortifying allies with bark, bloom, and primal vigor.
Walk with the animal spirits of Azeroth as a proud totem warrior, mauling foes and invoking the fury of the wild.
Move stone and turn the earth wielding two powerful weapons to defend you and your allies from harm.
Wield two one-handed weapons and use them in conjunction with powerful engravings to pummel your foes with wild primordial magic.
Invoke frost, flame, and arcane glyphs in rapid succession, bombarding foes with layered elemental power and primordial force.
Bring destruction upon your enemies with grace while wielding a two-handed weapon and powerful devastating magical attacks.
Summon the power of the earth from the depths of Azeroth to unleash devastating magic upon enemies.
Become overtaken by the might of Y'shaarj, transforming into an immovable bulwark of eldritch magic that absorbs incoming attacks.
Don your witchmail and wield a two-handed sword to deflect attacks and defend allies.
Bathe your companions in radiant sunlight, mending grievous wounds and empowering them with steadfast hope and divine blessings.
Transform into a monstrosity that is able to attract the attention of devastingly powerful foes.
Become a mana infused bulwark shielding the secrets of the cosmos from unwelcome influences.
Master the art of rejuvenation through poisons and venom, creating a delicate balance between life and death.
